sonnet.problem: The blank has the baker complete Jesus's line in Matthew 19:6 ('what God has joined together, let man not separate'). No earlier card shows that wording, so the baker has to guess the next words of a line. Ask about the meaning instead, for example what Jesus says about those whom God has joined.
sonnet.rule: The rule against guessing the next words of a line (see below) applies to every passage, and to fill in the blank too. The blank tests meaning the baker can reason out, not wording they haven't seen.
